items.name: engine_speed_rpm
items.label: Engine speed
items.description: Actual engine speed, calculated over a minimum crankshaft angle of 720 degrees divided by the number of cylinders.

gold_use.text: Engine running: engine speed ≥ 300 rpm (fresh and valid).

items.name: accelerator_pedal_pct
items.label: Accelerator pedal position
items.description: Accelerator pedal position 1: actual position relative to the maximum position of the primary accelerator control.

items.name: engine_load_pct
items.label: Engine load at current speed
items.description: Engine percent load at current speed: actual engine percent torque (indicated) relative to maximum indicated torque available at the current engine speed, clipped to zero torque during engine braking.

caveats.text: Load relative to the maximum torque available at the current engine speed, clipped to 0 during engine braking. Not absolute torque or power.

gold_use.text: Average engine load reported per event.

items.name: wheel_speed_kph
items.label: Wheel-based vehicle speed
items.description: Wheel-based vehicle speed, calculated from wheel or tailshaft speed. FMS note: may differ from tachograph speed.
items.reference: FMS-Standard v02.00 (11.11.2010) §1.1 p.5 CCVS; SAE J1939-71 SPN 84

caveats.text: Calculated from wheel or tailshaft speed; FMS notes it may vary from tachograph speed.

gold_use.text: Stationary: wheel speed < 0.5 km/h (fresh and valid).

items.name: cruise_control_active
items.label: Cruise control active
items.description: Cruise control is switched on. Does not guarantee the engine is being controlled by cruise control (driver demand may exceed it).
items.reference: FMS-Standard v02.00 (11.11.2010) §1.1 p.5 CCVS; SAE J1939-71 SPN 595

caveats.text: Cruise control switched on; this does not guarantee the engine is under cruise control.

items.name: brake_switch
items.label: Brake switch
items.description: Driver-operated service brake foot pedal is pressed. Does not cover park brake, retarder or engine brake.
items.reference: FMS-Standard v02.00 (11.11.2010) §1.1 p.5 CCVS; SAE J1939-71 SPN 597

caveats.text: Service-brake foot pedal only; not the park brake, retarder or engine brake.

items.name: clutch_switch
items.label: Clutch switch
items.description: Clutch pedal is pressed. FMS overview: trucks with automatic gear send this as not available.
items.reference: FMS-Standard v02.00 (11.11.2010) §1.1 p.5 CCVS + p.30 overview; SAE J1939-71 SPN 598

caveats.text: FMS-Standard: trucks with an automatic gearbox send this as not available. This truck sends raw 11 (not available) in 100 % of frames.

items.name: fuel_rate_lph
items.label: Fuel rate
items.description: Amount of fuel consumed by the engine per unit of time. FMS: calculated values given as indications, not as contractual values.

caveats.text: FMS: fuel values are indications, not contractual values. Integrated fuel reconciles with the SPN 5054 counter per session.

gold_use.text: Event fuel: fuel rate integrated over the event on the 100 ms grid.

items.name: total_fuel_used_l
items.label: Total fuel used (high resolution)
items.description: High resolution engine total fuel used: accumulated fuel used during vehicle operation. FMS: implemented if technically possible.

caveats.text: 0.001 L resolution, but advances in ~0.01 L steps in this data. FMS: an indication, not a contractual value.

gold_use.text: Fuel counter used to reconcile integrated fuel per session.

items.name: total_distance_m
items.label: Total vehicle distance (high resolution)
items.description: High resolution total vehicle distance: accumulated distance travelled by the vehicle during its operation.

gold_use.text: Distance counter used to reconcile integrated distance per session.

items.name: coolant_temp_c
items.label: Engine coolant temperature
items.description: Engine coolant temperature: temperature of liquid found in the engine cooling system.

gold_use.text: Coolant at start/end; 'cold engine at start' tag below 60 °C.

items.name: ambient_temp_c
items.label: Ambient air temperature
items.description: Ambient air temperature: temperature of air surrounding the vehicle.

caveats.text: Not trustworthy as outside air temperature: it read +19.9 °C on a −17 °C morning (session C), consistent with sensor heat soak. FleetPulse uses it only as context.
